title: Wire Meal Plans tab into a real browser entry point
description: Replace the tab placeholder with a real meal-plans browser entry point and add list-entry loading logic that derives display counts from parsed plans.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlansTab` renders the new browser view using the configured recipes folder URL.
List entry loading resolves plan files through `MealPlanFiles.discover(in:)`.
Each entry computes the deduped recipe count needed by card rows and detail headers.
No regression is introduced to the tab shell or folder-gating assumptions.

handoff_summary.completed: MealPlansTab now reads folderURL from RecipesFolderStore environment and delegates to MealPlansView. MealPlansView implements the browser pattern (NavigationStack, search, FAB, create-blank-plan alert, three empty states). loadEntries resolves plan files via MealPlanFiles.discover(in:), parses each file with MealPlanParser.parse, and computes deduped recipe count. MealPlanCardView shows name, relative date, and recipe count. Navigation destination to detail view is stubbed with Text — detail view is a follow-up bead.
handoff_summary.remaining: Detail view (MealPlanDetailView) is not part of this bead — the navigation destination is currently a stub Text view. A follow-up bead should implement the collapsible-section detail with swipe-delete and create-shopping-list CTA.
handoff_summary.risks: None. All changes are additive — MealPlansTab previously showed an EmptyStateView with no environment dependency; the tab shell (AppRoot) already gates the TabView behind folderURL != nil, so the force-unwrap in MealPlansTab is safe by the same invariant used in ShoppingListsTab and RecipesTab.
handoff_summary.next_action: Implement MealPlanDetailView with collapsible ==block== sections, recipe/text/ingredient rows, swipe-delete items, delete-plan toolbar action, and stubbed create-shopping-list CTA.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: MealPlanCardView.swift is a net-new file with no overlap risk. MealPlansView.swift is net-new. MealPlansTab.swift was a stub — the only prior consumers are AppRoot (unchanged). No sibling bead touches these files.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Navigation destination is stubbed as Text rather than removed entirely, so the NavigationStack push path is set up correctly for a follow-up detail-view bead to drop into. Deduped recipe count uses Set over .recipe path strings, matching the spec's 'deduped recipe count' requirement. Blank plan is created as '---\n---\n' (frontmatter-only), which MealPlanParser.parse returns as an empty MealPlan with no blocks — semantically correct and round-trips cleanly.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Test execution is the tester agent's responsibility. The loadEntries deduplication logic (Set over .recipe paths) is the only non-trivial logic and is a candidate for a unit test in CookbookAppTests.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Navigation destination is a Text placeholder — tapping a card shows only the plan name until MealPlanDetailView is implemented. SourceKit diagnostics in the worktree are noise (no .xcodeproj exists until XcodeGen regenerates).

conflict_risks: MealPlanCardView.swift is a net-new file with no overlap risk. MealPlansView.swift is net-new. MealPlansTab.swift was a stub — the only prior consumers are AppRoot (unchanged). No sibling bead touches these files.

execution_history.summary: Replaced MealPlansTab placeholder with a real browser entry point. Created MealPlansView (list + search + FAB + create flow) and MealPlanCardView, wired MealPlansTab to forward folderURL from the RecipesFolderStore environment. Entry loading uses MealPlanFiles.discover(in:) and MealPlanParser.parse to derive the deduped recipe count (unique .recipe paths via Set) for each card row.
